case_classification.short_description: Very complex and extensive debt waterfall model (Father of all debt waterfall models) - daily model including interest conventions and additional annual overview

ai_time_estimate_reasoning: This is an exceptionally complex daily financial modeling task spanning 10 years (3,652 days) with 8 senior debt tranches, subordinated debt, and 3 convertible debt tranches converting into equity. The modeler must set up dynamic date logic (to handle weekends, first/last weekdays, and the 15th of the month), implement interest calculations across three day-count conventions (Act/360, Act/365, 30/360 US) and two quoting conventions (EAR and Nominal), model a strict 25-step daily waterfall sequence, and track a dynamic cap table where new convertible-debt-driven Class B shares vest 2 years post-conversion (subject to a minimum vesting date). Building, debugging, and auditing this massive daily schedule and answering the extensive set of specific date-based queries would take an expert modeler approximately 5 hours.
